goal: Move full project regression such as npm test -- out of the normal test-execute repair loop and run it as a late final-regression step. Finish and validate the existing uncommitted 30a7 implementation without re-implementing already completed work.

analysis.problem: Recent SDD flows repeatedly run full project regression from test-execute, so review or gate repairs make the test artifact stale and trigger another expensive npm test -- inside the normal repair loop.
analysis.proposedApproach: Keep normal test-execute focused on spec-local and targeted evidence, defer full project regression to a final-regression step after retro, and route final-regression failures by failure kind instead of sending them back through the normal gate-impl loop.
analysis.validation: The approach addresses the root loop because full regression no longer participates in ordinary repair iterations, while final-regression still preserves release confidence before finalize.

knownFacts: Issue #330 says the current working tree already contains uncommitted 30a7 implementation and must not be re-implemented.
Issue #330 lists final-regression step, registry command, runner, artifact fields, failure issue-log recording, and test.testExecuteRegression policy as already implemented.

Issue #330 lists get-next-action failures, rawText/rawOutputText evidence validation mismatch, stale scenario-validity wording, coarse failure classification, and missing flow-level measurement as remaining work.
Full npm test -- should not run anywhere other than final-regression by default; explicit test.testExecuteRegression=full is the configured exception.
Final-regression failures should not return to the normal gate-impl loop; each failure kind has one return or stop path and automatic repair is limited to one attempt.
Final-regression result artifacts are a consumer contract for report, review, gate, issue-log, and next-action behavior.
The requested flow is active as a spec-only flow on main so the existing uncommitted implementation remains available.
Draft guardrails require one concern, unambiguous requirements, complete context, prioritized requirements, and explicit impact on existing features.
The project rule prohibits adding external dependencies and requires sdd-forge upgrade after template or preset changes.
decisionPoints: Where full project regression is allowed to run in the SDD lifecycle.
Which test-execute regression modes are valid and how targeted, full, and skip policies affect the normal repair loop.
How final-regression artifacts represent pass, failure classification, retryability, raw output, and next action.
How final-regression failures route without re-entering review or gate-impl loops unnecessarily.
What evidence proves full npm test -- no longer enters normal test-execute by default.
What existing implementation gaps must be fixed before finalization.
resolvedByProjectRules: Use Node.js built-in modules only; do not add dependencies.
Do not write compatibility shims for obsolete alpha behavior unless explicitly required by the spec.
If src/templates or src/presets are changed, run sdd-forge upgrade and keep installed skills in sync.
Do not modify tests merely to make tests pass; fix product behavior when the scenario is valid.
Commit messages must be English and must not include sign-off or co-authored-by trailers.
requiresUserJudgment: No unresolved user judgment remains after applying issue #330's implementation status and failure-routing policy.
deferredToSpec: Translate the issue's already-implemented and remaining-work lists into must/should requirements.
Define final-regression artifact acceptance criteria and issue-log expectations.
Define targeted/full/skip test-execute policy acceptance criteria.
Define test coverage for next-action wiring, raw output evidence validation, prompt wording, and final-regression behavior.
Define non-goals that prevent re-implementing the existing 30a7 diff.

in: Finish the existing uncommitted 30a7 implementation for moving full project regression to final-regression.
Fix remaining final-regression next-action, evidence validation, stale prompt wording, and classification issues identified by issue #330.
Verify that default normal test-execute does not run full npm test -- and records deferral or targeted evidence correctly.
Run the required template upgrade and focused tests needed to validate the changed flow behavior.
out: Re-implementing the already present final-regression step, registry command, runner, artifact schema, or test-execute policy from scratch.
Changing unrelated draft/spec/review/gate/finalize behavior beyond what is needed for final-regression integration.

impactOnExisting: gate-impl expectations around missing full regression evidence
reports, retro output, prompts, installed skills, guardrails, and locale messages

qa.question: 通常の test-execute では、既定で full npm test -- を実行せず、full regression が必要な場合は final-regression へ defer されたことを artifact で確認できればよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。通常の test-execute は spec-local または targeted evidence に限定し、既定では full regression を final-regression へ defer したことを artifact で確認できる必要がある。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 states: full npm test must not run anywhere other than final-regression, and the normal test-execute default is targeted with full-regression-deferred.
qa.why: 重い補修ループの主因が test-execute 内の full npm test -- なので、artifact で defer を検証できることが受け入れ条件になる。

qa.question: test.testExecuteRegression が full に明示設定された場合だけ、通常の test-execute 内で project full regression を実行できる、という例外を維持してよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。明示的に test.testExecuteRegression=full が設定された場合だけ、通常の test-execute 内で full regression を実行できる例外を維持する。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 says targeted project test paths run in the normal loop, and full regression runs inside test-execute only when full is explicitly configured.
qa.why: 既定の重いループを避けつつ、利用者が明示的に full を要求した設定は尊重する必要がある。

qa.question: final-regression の failureKind 分類は、pre_existing と caused_by_current_change の誤分類リスクをこの issue 内で明確化する必要がありますか。
qa.answer: はい。final-regression は raw output または failing test metadata が changedFiles のいずれかへ具体的に結び付く場合だけ caused_by_current_change として regression-repair を選ぶ。結び付きがない失敗は regression-repair に送らず、pre_existing または retryable=false の stop 系 nextAction に分類する。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 lists coarse pre_existing / caused_by_current_change classification as remaining work and warns that changed files alone can misclassify unrelated failures.
qa.why: 変更差分との具体的な結び付きがない failure を repair に送らない条件なら、unrelated failure が current-change repair loop に入ることを検証できるため。

qa.question: final-regression failure は failureKind ごとに戻り先を 1 つに限定し、修復可能な current-change failure も自動 repair は 1 回まで、2 回目は stop としてよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。failureKind ごとに単一の戻り先または stop を選び、repairable failure の自動 repair は初回だけ、2 回目は stop とする。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 states final-regression failure must not route back into the normal gate-impl loop, lists one return point per failure kind, and limits automatic repair to one attempt.
qa.why: 戻り先を複数持つと review/gate/test の責務が混線し、同じ failure が再分類されて無駄な修正ループに入る。

qa.question: gate-impl は full regression 未実行を blocker とせず、final-regression が後段で project-level confidence を担保する責務分離でよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。gate-impl は full regression 未実行を blocker にせず、project-level confidence は後段の final-regression が担保する。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 implementation candidates include: gate-impl does not treat missing full regression as a blocker.
qa.why: gate-impl が full regression を要求すると、full npm test -- が通常補修ループへ戻り、今回の目的に反する。

qa.question: 完了判定には、final-regression 個別テスト、test-regression policy テスト、get-next-action 関連テスト、raw output evidence validation の回帰テストを含める必要がありますか。
qa.answer: はい。既存の passing 個別テストに加え、get-next-action wiring と raw output evidence validation を回帰対象に含める。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 says final-regression.test.js and test-regression-policy.test.js pass individually, while get-next-action tests and rawText/rawOutputText validation remain broken.
qa.why: 残作業として明示された破損箇所を検証しないと、flow の収束性や artifact 信頼性が確認できない。

qa.question: final-regression-result artifact の consumer は、failureKind、command、rawOutputPath、retryable、nextAction、changedFiles、previousFailureKind を安定した契約として扱ってよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。これらの field は final-regression artifact の安定した契約として扱い、validator、report、issue-log、next-action が同じ意味で読む必要がある。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 lists these fields as already implemented artifact data and uses them for failure routing, retryability, and log inspection.
qa.why: consumer ごとに解釈がずれると、failure 分類や retry 判定が不安定になり、承認漏れや検知漏れにつながる。

qa.question: 既存の未コミット差分にある実装済み項目は再実装せず、レビューして不足分だけ修正することをこの spec の非ゴールとして固定してよいですか。
qa.answer: はい。既存の未コミット差分は実装済みとして扱い、再実装せず、不足分の修正と検証だけを行う。
qa.evidence: Issue #330 explicitly says the already implemented items are present as uncommitted working tree changes and must not be re-implemented.
qa.why: 既存 diff を重複実装すると、差分が膨らみ、レビュー対象と責務境界が不明瞭になる。
